preconditions.description: The input string s is not empty.
The length of the input string s is between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s contains only characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The output string t has the same length as the input string s.

postconditions.expression: t.count('0') == max(s.count('0') for s in all_substrings(s))
postconditions.description: The output string t has the maximum possible number of zeroes.

postconditions.expression: all(lcs(s[l-1:r]) == lcs(t[l-1:r]) for l in range(1, len(s)+1) for r in range(l, len(s)+1))
postconditions.description: For any l and r, the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence of the substring s[l:r] is equal to the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence of the substring t[l:r].
